name: vestipro-integration-suite
description: Orquestra a suite completa de testes de integracao contra o Firebase Emulator Suite (TASK-162): Firestore/Storage Security Rules, Cloud Functions criticas (precificacao, numero de pedido, aprovacoes) e os testes de integracao client-side do app Flutter. Pensado para ser plugado diretamente num job de CI (TASK-165).

scripts.test:flutter-integration: firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore,storage,functions "flutter test integration_test -d chrome"
scripts.test:integration: npm run test:rules:firestore && npm run test:rules:storage && npm run test:functions && npm run test:flutter-integration
